data.narrative:
Allen Control Systems, a Series B defense and security technology company founded by Mike Wior, Steve Simoni, and Luke Allen, has raised $200M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 10 companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms operating in the same sector and stage. The peer set includes Dream Security ($3.0B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), Defense Unicorns ($1.0B), and Heven AeroTech ($1.0B), with a sector median of $1.1B and range spanning $300M to $3.0B.

Two triangulation methods were applied. The stage-progression approach applies a 1.9x multiplier to the $200M total raised proxy, yielding $380M. The peer-median method anchors directly to the 6 same-sector, same-stage comparables, implying $1.1B. These methods reflect different assumptions about capital deployment efficiency and peer pricing.

The triangulated range is $323M (low) to $1.3B (high), with a median of $752M. The material gap between the stage-progression result and peer medians reflects uncertainty around whether Allen Control Systems trades at a discount to or premium relative to the identified peer set. Key sensitivities include product maturity, customer concentration, and relative technical differentiation within the defense and security sector. Additional clarity on revenue run-rate and contract pipeline would narrow the valuation range.
